title: Non-binary bottom-up constituency parsing without arity actions
abstract: arXiv:2607.10591v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Non-binary bottom-up constituency parsing commonly uses arity-specific reductions such as \(\textsc{Reduce-}X\#k\), which jointly specify the mother label and number of children. We show that arity need not be a primitive transition parameter. The proposed parser predicts the mother label separately and identifies the ordered child sequence from a delimiter-bounded stack configuration. In every well-formed reducible configuration, the active delimiter, label marker, and intervening completed items uniquely determine the reduction domain and hence its arity. This factorization removes label--arity-specific reduction actions while preserving direct construction of the original non-binary trees. Controlled experiments on PTB and CTB show that the delimiter-guided parser closely tracks an arity-specific baseline while using a substantially smaller action inventory. translated_title: 无动作数约束的非二进自底向上成分句法分析
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.10591v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：非二进自底向上的成分句法分析通常使用特定于动作数的归约操作，如\(\textsc{Reduce-}X\#k\)，这些操作同时指定母节点标签和子节点数量。我们证明动作数并非必需的原始转移参数。所提出的解析器分别预测母节点标签，并从由分隔符限定的栈配置中识别有序子节点序列。在每个良构的可归约配置中，活动分隔符、标签标记和其间已完成的条目唯一确定归约域及其动作数。这种分解消除了标签-动作数特定的归约操作，同时保留了原始非二进树的直接构建。在PTB和CTB上的对照实验表明，分隔符引导的解析器在使用显著更小动作库的同时，紧密跟踪动作数特定的基线。其预测树保留了金标准的分支结构，而无系统性偏差。
tldr: 本文提出一种无需动作数参数的非二进成分句法分析方法，通过分隔符限定栈配置来唯一确定归约域，从而减少动作库规模并保持树结构准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a non-binary constituency parsing method without arity-specific actions, using delimiter-bounded stack configurations to uniquely determine reduction domains, thereby reducing the action inventory while preserving tree structure accuracy.
